_comment: 'Amp 3. You may destroy a Lightning Flow you control. If you do, this gets go again.' The grant is already correctly gated -- MAY around the destroy, then CONDITIONAL on REF_EXISTS "destroyed", so declining or having nothing to destroy withholds it. Only the printed keyword was wrong: it applied unconditionally, so the player got go again whether or not they paid a Lightning Flow for it, which is the entire decision the card asks for. Declared rather than converted because "if you DO" is about a choice made at resolution, not a state a static could re-read.
